# Whole-project test inventory and evidence boundaries

This is a read-only inventory of clean public commit `9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854` on `ws/test-inventory-audit`. It explains what is configured and what source declares. The auditor ran no tests or tooling. Fresh passed/failed/skipped results belong to root’s separately observed execution and must be joined by exact source and host; they are not invented from file counts.

## Fresh execution and silent-pass boundaries

Root separately ran the exact public `9e62a15` default Node/DOM suite on macOS ARM64: **16,462 passed, 0 failed, 364 skipped/pending, 16,826 total across 807 files**, observed exit 0 in 606.97 seconds. Opt-ins were disabled; no Docker or API startup occurred. This auditor did not execute tests. The raw report hash matches root’s [execution receipt](private-evidence:complete-test-audit-20261003/public-unit-9e62a15-receipt.json); [raw per-case JSON](private-evidence:complete-test-audit-20261003/public-unit-9e62a15.json) remains the authoritative source of names/statuses. The freshly captured remote Linux CI run37103826519 at the same public9e commit reports 16,427 passed, 0 failed and 399 skipped; see the [current remote evidence](private-evidence:complete-test-audit-20261003/test-remote-evidence-audit/remote-job-evidence-audit.json). The older CI746 summary is historical, even though its unit totals happen to match. Local binary discovery changes execution; these numbers must not be summed with dedicated lanes or used to claim all production acceptance passed.

A returned test body is normally a pass even if it never reaches an assertion. A runner-visible `ctx.skip()` records a skip. The following nine return sites in seven files need that distinction. The conditional branches below were reviewed in source; except the explicitly reproduced shell helper defect, they are not new runtime-confirmed failures. Some are intentional unsupported-backend exemptions whose displayed pass does not prove that backend behavior. No count is deducted from root’s observed totals.

Cleanup remains in finally. |

**Confirmed validation gap AUDIT-SSM-SHELL-01:** [native helper construction](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/machines/_sh.ts#L34) invokes `sh sh -s`. Root’s harmless probe observed exit126; `sh -s` produced the expected marker with exit 0. The false unavailable result disables 13 shell document cases and makes the hostile argv round-trip body return before assertions. [Private finding receipt](private-evidence:complete-test-audit-20261003/ssm-shell-probe-finding.json) binds the same source hashes. This is an unfixed harness verification gap; it establishes no SSM/cloud mutation vulnerability. Fixing it is follow-up work outside this audit.

The source search also found early returns in lifecycle hooks, polling/helpers, AST visitors, simulated response handlers and branches after an assertion that would already fail. Those are not labeled silent-case passes. Full lexical matches and reviewed exclusions are in `silentPrerequisiteReturnAudit` in the JSON. This bounded search does not prove every pass contains an assertion or that all possible prerequisite paths were discovered.

Dynamic runner skips are separately recorded at [workflow shared fixture](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/workflows/support.ts#L368), [workflow client](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/workflows/client.test.ts#L283), [platform actual Temporal fixture](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/platform/deploy-e2e.test.ts#L143) and [security JSON parser prerequisite](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/_support/security/runtime.ts#L103). Shared Temporal required mode fails when the prerequisite is unavailable; optional default suites may record skips. These helper-driven sites are additional to the 86 literal `skipIf/runIf/skip/todo` source sites; neither source-site count is an executed-case count.

## What the source inventory contains

The public checkout has **807 Vitest test files:724 Node and83 DOM**, **37 Go test files** with **230 top-level Test function declarations**, and **6 Rego test files** with **213 test_ rule declarations**. One Rego file (`fixtures_test.rego`) supplies fixtures and declares no test_ rule. There are no additional tracked `.spec.*` or `.test.js` files outside these sets. Every file, SHA256, source declaration location, explicit guard and lexical evidence marker is in `inventory.json`. These are source units, not executed case counts. Go build tags and OS conditions change the compiled set; Vitest each/backend matrices and dynamic suites expand at runtime.

Vitest uses two projects with exact filename includes, node versus jsdom,20-second test and60-second hook budgets; DOM setup is explicit. References: [vitest.config.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/vitest.config.ts#L14), [tests/dom-setup.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/dom-setup.ts). A DOM test can exercise controls/focus/roles with fixtures; it does not execute a Chrome rendering engine.

## Configured commands and gates

`npm test` is Vitest over the Node/DOM projects. `npm verify` chains typecheck, lint, test, smoke and Gimbal. It is a core check; it does not itself run all PostgreSQL, OPA build, Temporal-required, provider-network, browser, kind, packaged-worker or live acceptance gates. `test:contract` is a product-store contract selection with file parallelism disabled, and enabled implementations still depend on keys/backend prerequisites. References: [package.json](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/package.json#L12), [scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs#L47), [tests/db/contract/factories.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/db/contract/factories.ts#L21).

### Canonical real-engine lanes

The five lane `files` arrays are **Vitest positional match strings**, not exclusive directory selectors. Locked Vitest4.1.11 compares case-insensitive substrings of project-relative test paths after configured Node/DOM discovery. Thus `tests/platform` also selects `tests/platform-ui`: freshness and reads/loaders Node files plus interactions, pages, teardown-page and teardown DOM files. The workflows lane selects **45 unique files**, while its validator requires **44 groups**; those are different units. The explicit `--exclude tests/workflows/mtls-live.test.ts` removes that one file. The other four lanes have no explicit `excludeFiles` entry. Source derivation across all 807 included paths gives PostgreSQL 9, policy 7, OpenTofu 121, workflows 45 and platform PostgreSQL 46; every set exactly matches the captured current remote job file rows without missing/extra/duplicate files. References: [canonical command construction](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs#L214), [locked Vitest filtering implementation](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/node_modules/vitest/dist/chunks/cli-api.CnMVyzaz.js#L10927), [current remote file rows](private-evidence:complete-test-audit-20261003/test-remote-evidence-audit/remote-job-evidence-audit.json). File-by-file selections, exclusions, Node/DOM split and comparison are recorded in JSON.

Each dedicated lane uses its own manifest filters, effective environment, serial worker, JSON report and strict required-group validation. An arbitrary passing report cannot define requirements. Failed/missing/skipped/zero required groups or bad observed execution evidence refuse acceptance. Whole-file/default tests outside mandatory groups can still include opt-ins. References: [scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs#L147), [scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs#L208), [tests/ci/assert-lane-report.mjs](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/ci/assert-lane-report.mjs#L14), [scripts/ci/run-gate.mjs](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/ci/run-gate.mjs#L11).

### Browser, smoke, image and scenario checks outside Vitest totals

Hosted acceptance builds the tracker app locally, uses a real loopback gateway/SQLite/encrypted backup and restore. Hosted browser uses installed Chromium-family rendering, keyboard interactions, cookies, record conflict and revocation in local recipe-backed serving. The agent journey uses shipping route/auth/action code with a loopback identity-provider double and explicitly simulated sandbox deployment. Agent browser renders the consent screen in an installed browser. Missing browser is a failure, not a skipped success. Their scripted checks are not Playwright test cases and are not part of the807-file inventory. References: [scripts/hosted-acceptance.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/hosted-acceptance.ts#L1), [scripts/hosted-browser.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/hosted-browser.ts#L1), [scripts/agent-acceptance.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/agent-acceptance.ts#L18), [scripts/agent-browser.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/agent-browser.ts#L1).

Smoke exercises real product actions/engine over the sandbox provider for success and rollback. Screenshots/visual QA are separate scripts/dated docs. Public Docker CI builds the application image; worker runtime acceptance is an explicit architecture-scoped harness with real disposable dependencies, rather than a Docker-build success. References: [scripts/smoke.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/smoke.ts#L1), [scripts/screenshots.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/screenshots.ts), [scripts/acceptance/packaged-worker.mjs](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/acceptance/packaged-worker.mjs#L1).

### A–J original-product scenario boundary

The live harness declares A autonomous AWS deploy, B diagnosis, C approved remediation, D drift, E crash recovery, F token revocation, G Kubernetes, H MCP, I managed provider and J multicloud planning. A–I require external/default-composition prerequisites and remain documented separately from local contracts; J proves local planning only. The harness dry run evaluates prerequisites without mutation and records criteria skipped. Any missing/skipped criterion makes a real scenario incomplete. Dependencies must pass earlier in the same run; approval criterion requires actual human browser review where required. References: [scripts/acceptance/scenarios/index.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/acceptance/scenarios/index.ts#L15), [scripts/acceptance/runner.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/acceptance/runner.ts#L1), [docs/platform/ACCEPTANCE.md](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/docs/platform/ACCEPTANCE.md#L29).

## What is real, what is a fixture, and what each result can prove

### Bare PostgreSQL authority/control store

Required inputs: `SUPABASE_DB_URL + ZENITH_CONTRACT_POSTGRES=1 (authority SQL)`; `ZENITH_TEST_PLATFORM_PG_URL (control store)`.

Actual execution boundary: Actual independent database pools and SQL/migration/lease/approval concurrency. PGlite uses one mutex-serialized connection; no PostgREST/auth/TLS/pooler/cloud proof.

References: [tests/controlplane/_support/harness.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/controlplane/_support/harness.ts#L4), [tests/controlplane/_support/harness.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/controlplane/_support/harness.ts#L30), [scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs#L74).

### Product/hosted Supabase HTTP data and artifact storage

Required inputs: `ZENITH_CONTRACT_POSTGRES=1`; `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`; `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`; `Applied hosted/data/atomic migrations and exposed hosted schema`; `Actual artifact bucket for storage suite`.

Actual execution boundary: Explicit external Supabase PostgREST and Storage calls when opted in. Bare PostgreSQL CI service does not supply these services; default product store contracts use FileStore only.

## Explicit skips, exclusions and disappearing backend rows

The auditor found86 explicit Vitest skipIf/runIf/skip/todo guard sites and18 Go t.Skip call sites in public source. These are source sites, not skipped-case counts: one skipped describe can suppress many cases; dynamic helpers and absent backend matrix rows may not appear as skipped cases at all. The JSON lists each site with file/line/source condition. The default config does not exclude a domain; the workflows lane deliberately excludes external mTLS.

The major categories are missing real PostgreSQL/Supabase services, optional binary/provider network, unavailable Temporal server, explicit source/cluster/systemd opts, OS/POSIX behavior, shell/Python/OpenSSL availability, and certain host filesystem differences. A passing default run does not clear those prerequisites. Real SQL/store matrices require exact ancestry checks, not a test title that mentions PostgreSQL. References: [tests/controlplane/_support/harness.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/controlplane/_support/harness.ts#L30), [scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs#L120), [tests/workflows/support.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/workflows/support.ts#L128).

Hosted PostgREST/storage requires a real Supabase service, source-store and vault-rewrap SQL tests are outside the dedicated selected paths, kind is separately opted in, and `tests/execution/deletion-guards-real.test.ts` has its own flag and is outside public tofu filters. ## Passed/failed/skipped evidence that is available versus not yet assigned

The auditor ran no tests. Current source-bound execution evidence is separately available from root’s macOS9e full-unit receipt and the captured Linux9e CI run37103826519. The latter reports 16,427 passed / 0 failed / 399 skipped across 807 files, and 13 successful jobs with 1 supply-chain failure. Its remote per-file rows match all five independently recomputed source filter sets. This does not erase historical failures, prove assertion execution in silent-return branches, or establish the remaining live release contracts. Reference: [current remote job evidence](private-evidence:complete-test-audit-20261003/test-remote-evidence-audit/remote-job-evidence-audit.json). Earlier committed summaries remain historical observations.

The latest committed remote summary describes run37098189258 at746e4e:13 jobs passed and1 supply-chain job failed. It reports16,427 passed/0 failed/399 skipped unit cases, with785 files passed and22 files skipped. Dedicated PostgreSQL251, platform PostgreSQL1422, policy238, tofu3900 and workflows982 have0failed/0skipped in that specific historical run. These lanes overlap each other/the full suite; do not sum them. It also distinguishes213OPA checks, Go package invocations without individual counts, browser scripted checks and non-counted smoke. The remote raw assertion reports/private inventories were unavailable for complete independent replay, as that summary states. Reference: [docs/build/production/ci-37098189258.md](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/docs/build/production/ci-37098189258.md).

The same summary keeps the complete-lock dependency advisory gate blocking. Test success cannot convert a failed mandatory advisory audit into acceptance, and older clean audit observations do not predict new advisories. Historical a14 was green at its own source/time; it is distinct from current source and the newer red run.

## Production mission coverage and remaining gaps

The exact public production ledger contains78 requirements: **5 verified**, **19 in progress**, **54 planned**. All four release flags are false: implementation complete, sandbox verified, pilot ready and production approved. These are ledger records, not fresh test outcomes. Reference: [docs/build/production/ledger.json](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/docs/build/production/ledger.json).

A contract-rich test suite is necessary but cannot alone prove the original mission: default clean-host browser/API/MCP composition, independent live application/provider readback, mixed-cloud execution/connectivity, managed tenant serving/isolation under load, scoped standing grants, recovery/rolling upgrade/custody, production auth/TLS/pooler, and operator SLO/RPO/RTO/commercial signoff require their declared evidence levels. The following table includes every mission requirement so source breadth cannot hide acceptance gaps. ## Audit findings and what root should do next

### INVENTORY-01
A public source inventory, historical public CI and isolated newer source are three distinct evidence scopes. Do not report staging durable/schema7, runner rotation or dirty guest files as executed at public9e. Documentation can archive newer evidence without shipping its source. References: [docs/build/production/ci-37098189258.md](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/docs/build/production/ci-37098189258.md), [docs/build/production/evidence/durable-plan/corrections-staging.json](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/docs/build/production/evidence/durable-plan/corrections-staging.json).

### INVENTORY-02
npm verify is a core script chain, not complete product verification. It covers typecheck/lint/Vitest/smoke/Gimbal only; dedicated SQL, OPA build, network OpenTofu, real Temporal, installed browsers, images/clusters/external/live gates require their own execution. References: [package.json](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/package.json#L18), [scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs#L47), [.github/workflows/ci.yml](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/.github/workflows/ci.yml).

### INVENTORY-03
Baseline backend opt-ins can disappear from execution without a skipped count. When PG_URL or Supabase keys are absent, some describe.each backend matrices contain only PGlite/FileStore. A zero-skipped default report cannot prove PostgreSQL or PostgREST coverage; strict required backend ancestry/manifest matters. References: [tests/controlplane/_support/harness.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/controlplane/_support/harness.ts#L30), [tests/db/contract/factories.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/db/contract/factories.ts#L31), [scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs#L120).

### INVENTORY-04
Several live/OS/cluster opt-ins are not enabled by every public mandatory lane. Track private source, PostgREST/storage, vault PG rewrap, systemd, kind, external mTLS and dedicated deletion guard opt-ins separately; do not silently waive or claim their acceptance. References: [scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs#L73), [tests/secrets/rewrap.test.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/secrets/rewrap.test.ts#L362), [tests/execution/deletion-guards-real.test.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/execution/deletion-guards-real.test.ts#L20), [tests/sources/github-live.test.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/sources/github-live.test.ts#L7).

### INVENTORY-05
Contract and local-engine evidence has bounded claims even when passing. Real provider schema is not cloud apply; fake API/ports are not provider reachability; real local Temporal with fake activities is not HA/mTLS; browser fixture IDP is not real external identity; bare PG is not production DB TLS/pooler/auth/restore. References: [tests/providers/aws/drivers/compute/assemble.test.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/providers/aws/drivers/compute/assemble.test.ts#L9), [tests/platform/deploy-e2e.test.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/platform/deploy-e2e.test.ts#L1), [scripts/agent-acceptance.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/agent-acceptance.ts#L18), [tests/controlplane/_support/harness.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/tests/controlplane/_support/harness.ts#L10).

### INVENTORY-06
Lane/file/group/script-check totals overlap and have different counting units. Keep Vitest file/assertion results, Go package/root/subtest counts, Rego rule counts, browser scripted checks and build command exits separate. No whole-project grand total may sum them. References: [docs/build/production/ci-37098189258.md](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/docs/build/production/ci-37098189258.md), [vitest.config.ts](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/vitest.config.ts#L22), [scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs#L73).

### INVENTORY-07
Production mission coverage is materially broader than implemented test files. 78 requirements include default clean installation/live application traffic/mixed-cloud partitioning/managed isolation/operational recovery/supply chain/standing grants/commercial signoff. All release flags remain false; listed source tests or testPaths absence are not completion determinations. References: [docs/build/production/ledger.json](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/docs/build/production/ledger.json), [docs/build/production/ledger.json](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/docs/build/production/ledger.json), [docs/platform/ACCEPTANCE.md](https://github.com/GODOSTROYER/zenith/blob/9e62a15f57034bf21d8924a6c6e1e1c558bfe854/docs/platform/ACCEPTANCE.md#L29).

Root should join fresh9e raw results to this source inventory without replacing historical failures/skips, report each unique case within its own run/scope, preserve explicit optional/backend/environment reasons, and execute additional gates only within their authorized prerequisites. Native guest/root filesystem/golden requirements, default production topology, external cloud/account acceptance and operational release are separate. This report changes no source, policy, dependencies, permissions, release ledger or gate.
